```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  SUM(fg3m) AS total_fg3m,
  SUM(fg3a) AS total_fg3a,
  CASE WHEN SUM(fg3a) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(fg3m) AS REAL) / SUM(fg3a) ELSE NULL END AS fg3_pct
FROM dev.player_game_stats
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_fg3m DESC
LIMIT 1
```
